riskAssessment.reason: This adds the first typed Ingestion contract and a public application port. The contract must retain source facts without interpretation and keep Domain independent from external systems.
riskAssessment.reviewNotes: Deferred temporal parsing, content-hash computation, source authentication, persistence, and external adapter mapping are intentional out-of-scope follow-ups.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: src/features/ingestion/domain exposes validated Observation, IngestionReceipt, source metadata value objects, and source classification without imports from infrastructure, interface, network, database, LLM, or provider modules.

Empty observation identity, source URI, source title, observation timestamp, or content hash is rejected deterministically; duplicate observation identity in one receipt is rejected deterministically.
An accepted observation retains source URI, title, observation time, optional effective date, content hash, source tier, observation kind, and opaque payload without interpretation.
An IngestionReceipt preserves accepted observation order and provides a stable deduplicated observation identity view.
src/features/ingestion/application/mod.rs defines a public source collection port with explicit request and result types; no external adapter implementation is added in this Work Item.
Focused unit and integration tests cover construction failures, metadata preservation, opaque payload retention, receipt ordering, duplicate rejection, and the application port boundary.
The design spec and execution plan document the boundary, assumptions, no-goals, authorization evidence, and verification commands.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Keep Ingestion Domain pure and independent of external systems.
Preserve source facts and provenance; do not infer claims or scores.
Do not add dependencies for this contract.
Do not introduce trading, price prediction, or capital-action behavior.
Resolve issues within the current Work Item when they remain inside its Contract scope; open a successor only for a distinct or materially expanded boundary.

intent.problem: The roadmap has no typed boundary for bringing external observations into ORG-X while preserving provenance and leaving interpretation to later contexts.
constraints: Domain code must remain provider-free and deterministic.
The contract must preserve opaque source payloads and required source metadata.
The implementation must fit the existing Rust module and architecture-test conventions.
intent.rationale: A small validated observation and receipt contract gives later Evidence and pipeline WIs a stable input boundary without coupling acquisition mechanics to the Domain.
